  - paragraph: The few things the whole site runs on. Change them here and the showroom follows — immediately, everywhere.
  - text: 
  - heading "WhatsApp number" [level=2]
  - paragraph: Every chat button on the site opens this number. A wrong number here is a dead button for every buyer.
  - text: Number, with country code
  - textbox "Number, with country code": +234 800 000 0000
  - paragraph:  Valid — buttons will open a chat with this number.

  - paragraph: The one line under the brand on the home page. Say what you do, plainly.
  - text: Tagline

  - paragraph: Used when typing a car's costs. Existing cost lines keep the rate they were entered at — this setting only affects new entries.
  - text: Dollar rate ₦
  - spinbutton "Dollar rate": "1000"
  - text: per $1
  - paragraph: Landed cost = dollar costs × this rate + naira costs.

  - paragraph: Default prefilled on every new car — change per car if needed.
